case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(s). OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)No……………/2025 @ Diary No.236/2024)
summary: Motor accident compensation; student's notional income vs minimum wage; reliance on Harpreet Singh (2011) 1 SCC 343; 70% annual income for permanent disability; 40% future prospects; medical expenses; loss of marriage prospects; pain and suffering; special diet; total compensation recalculated to Rs.34,56,110/- with 7.5% interest from claim filing date excluding 642-day delay.

final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation enhanced to Rs.34,56,110/- with 7.5% interest from claim filing date excluding 642-day delay period.
